description: This file contains shell script functions and procedures for configuring and managing a MBIM (Mobile Broadband Interface Model) network interface using the umbim tool. It includes functions for initialization, setup, teardown, and configuration of network parameters, as well as handling device communication and network registration.

methods.name: proto_mbim_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration options for the MBIM protocol, setting default values and adding configuration parameters.

methods.name: _proto_mbim_get_field
methods.description: Extracts a specific field value from the MBIM configuration string.

methods.name: proto_mbim_setup
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls the internal setup function and handles retries on failure.

methods.name: proto_mbim_teardown
methods.description: Handles the teardown process for the MBIM network interface, disconnecting and updating state.
